name: Praying To Mary
overview: Scripture reveals that worship and prayer are to be directed to the LORD alone, who alone is exalted and worthy of praise, as highlighted in Psalms 148:13 and Exodus 20:4’s prohibition against making graven images. The practice of offering devotion to others, such as the 'queen of heaven' mentioned in Jeremiah 7:18, is condemned as provoking God's anger. While Mary is honored as the handmaid of the Lord who magnifies Him (Luke 1:38, 46) and is recognized as Jesus’ mother (Matthew 12:46), Scripture does not instruct believers to pray to her or elevate her to a mediatory role, emphasizing instead direct worship of God alone.
